verdict.rationale: dLocal documents an official MCP server that "acts as a bridge between your AI agent and dLocal's systems" (dlocal-docs-23). This plausibly lets a user drive the product through natural-language requests in an AI client, but that single line is the only evidence, and it does not say which operations are exposed. The ChatGPT/Claude links on doc pages only explain concepts or generate code (dlocal-docs-22), so they do not count as operating the product. Missing for 10: documentation of which payment, payout or reporting actions can be run via natural language, any native in-product natural-language interface, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
